title.zh: 卷388 列傳一百七十五 桂良 瑞麟子：怀塔布 官文 文煜
title.en: Volume 388 Biographies 175: Gui Liang, Rui Lin son: Huai Tabu, Guan Wen, Wen Yu
title.raw: 卷388 列傳一百七十五 桂良 瑞麟子：怀塔布 官文 文煜

sentences.zh: 桂良，字燕山，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲正紅旗人，閩浙總督玉德子。

translations.literal: Gui Liang, courtesy name Yanshan, of the Guwalgiya clan, a man of the Manchu Plain Red Banner, was the son of Yu De, governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Liang, whose courtesy name was Yanshan, belonged to the Guwalgiya clan of the Manchu Plain Red Banner and was the son of Yu De, governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 入貲為禮部主事，晉員外郎。

translations.literal: He purchased entry as a secretary in the Ministry of Rites and was promoted to vice director.
translations.idiomatic: He bought his way into a secretaryship in the Ministry of Rites and was later promoted to vice director.

sentences.zh: 出為四川順慶知府，調成都。

translations.literal: He went out to serve as prefect of Shunqing in Sichuan, then was transferred to Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted as prefect of Shunqing in Sichuan and later transferred to Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 歷建昌道，河南按察使，四川、廣東、江西布政使。

translations.literal: He successively served as Jianchang circuit intendant, Henan provincial surveillance commissioner, and provincial administration commissioners of Sichuan, Guangdong, and Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He held successive posts as Jianchang circuit intendant, Henan surveillance commissioner, and administration commissioners in Sichuan, Guangdong, and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 道光十四年，擢河南巡撫。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of the Daoguang reign, he was promoted to governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1834 he was promoted to governor of Henan.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶中，林清、李文成等以八卦教倡亂，既誅，而汲縣潞州屯墳塔猶祀其神曰「無生老母」，習教者猶眾。

translations.literal: During the Jiaqing reign, Lin Qing, Li Wencheng, and others had raised rebellion through the Eight Trigrams sect; after they were executed, the tomb pagoda at Lüzhou Tun in Ji County still enshrined their deity called the "Eternal Venerable Mother," and those who practiced the sect remained numerous.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jiaqing era Lin Qing, Li Wencheng, and others had stirred rebellion in the name of the Eight Trigrams sect. Though they were put to death, the tomb pagoda at Lüzhou Tun in Ji County still honored their god as the "Eternal Venerable Mother," and adherents of the sect remained plentiful.

sentences.zh: 御史黃爵滋以為言，命桂良察治，毀其墳廟，廉得河南境內無生廟三十九所，並毀之；

translations.literal: The censor Huang Juezi reported on this; Gui Liang was ordered to investigate and remedy the matter, destroy the tomb temples, and through investigation found thirty-nine Eternal Mother temples within Henan, all of which were likewise destroyed;
translations.idiomatic: When censor Huang Juezi brought the matter to court, Gui Liang was ordered to investigate. He demolished the tomb shrines and, on inquiry, found thirty-nine "Eternal Mother" temples within Henan and had them all torn down as well;

sentences.zh: 地方官失察，譴黜有差。

translations.literal: Local officials who had failed in oversight were reprimanded and demoted to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Local officials who had failed to detect the sect were censured and demoted in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 十九年，擢湖廣總督，調閩浙，又調雲貴。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, he was promoted to governor-general of Huguang, transferred to Fujian and Zhejiang, and then transferred to Yunnan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1839 he was made governor-general of Huguang, then transferred to Fujian-Zhejiang and afterward to Yunnan-Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 二十年，兼署雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, he concurrently served as acting governor of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1840 he also served concurrently as acting governor of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 滇省多盜，奏定緝捕章程；

translations.literal: Yunnan had many bandits; he memorialized to establish regulations for pursuit and capture;
translations.idiomatic: Because banditry was rife in Yunnan, he memorialized regulations for pursuit and capture;

sentences.zh: 又請迤南、迤西、迤東各標營官兵責成巡道就近稽察。

translations.literal: He also requested that the troops of the southern, western, and eastern frontier garrisons be charged to the circuit intendants nearby for inspection.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that troops of the southern, western, and eastern frontier garrisons be placed under nearby circuit intendants for local inspection.

sentences.zh: 時貴州諸苗蠢動，鎮遠、黎平、都勻、古州苗尤悍，州縣不能制，疏請遴勁兵專主剿捕。

translations.literal: At the time the various Miao of Guizhou were stirring; the Miao of Zhenyuan, Liping, Duyun, and Guzhou were especially fierce, and the prefectures and counties could not control them, so he memorialized requesting selection of strong troops devoted solely to suppression and pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile the Miao of Guizhou were rising in unrest; those of Zhenyuan, Liping, Duyun, and Guzhou were especially fierce, and local officials could not contain them, so he asked that elite troops be chosen to focus exclusively on suppression.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，入覲，留京，署兵部尚書，兼正白旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, he came to court for audience, remained in the capital, served as acting minister of War, and concurrently held the post of commandant of the Manchu Plain White Banner Chinese Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: In 1845 he came to court, remained in Beijing, served as acting minister of War, and concurrently commanded the Manchu Plain White Banner Chinese Brigade.

sentences.zh: 尋出為熱河都統。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he went out to serve as commandant of Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon posted as commandant of Rehe.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，召來京，以其女妻皇六子奕訢，授鑲紅旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, he was summoned to the capital; his daughter was given in marriage to the emperor's sixth son Yixin, and he was appointed commandant of the Manchu Bordered Red Banner Chinese Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: In 1848 he was recalled to Beijing; his daughter married the emperor's sixth son, Prince Yixin, and he was made commandant of the Manchu Bordered Red Banner Chinese Brigade.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，署吏部尚書，出為福州將軍。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng, he served as acting minister of Personnel and went out as general of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1851 he served as acting minister of Personnel and was posted as general of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 二年，召授兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the second year, he was summoned and appointed minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In 1852 he was recalled and appointed minister of War.

sentences.zh: 三年，粵匪陷江寧，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: In the third year, the Cantonese rebels captured Jiangning, and the capital was placed under martial alert.
translations.idiomatic: In 1853 the Taiping rebels took Nanjing, and Beijing was placed under martial law.

sentences.zh: 桂良疏請各城門稽查增派八旗章京兵丁，補葺城上兵房，從之。

translations.literal: Gui Liang memorialized requesting increased inspection at each city gate with additional Eight Banner clerks and soldiers, and repair of the barracks atop the walls; the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Liang asked that gate inspections be tightened with additional Eight Banner clerks and troops and that the barracks on the city walls be repaired; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 未幾，粵匪竄河北，直隸總督訥爾經額出省防剿，命桂良駐保定為後路聲援，兼防西路要隘。

translations.literal: Before long the Cantonese rebels fled into Hebei; Zhili governor-general Ne'ergeng'e went out of the province to defend and suppress them, and Gui Liang was ordered to station at Baoding as rear support and also to guard key passes on the western route.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the rebels fled into Hebei. While Zhili governor-general Ne'ergeng'e marched out to fight them, Gui Liang was ordered to hold Baoding as a rear base and guard the western passes.

sentences.zh: 望都、唐縣土匪起，捕誅之。

translations.literal: Bandits rose in Wangdu and Tang counties; they were captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits rose in Wangdu and Tang counties, he captured and executed them.

sentences.zh: 是年秋，賊由山西犯畿南，訥爾經額師潰於臨洺關，隆平、柏鄉相繼陷。

translations.literal: That autumn the rebels came from Shanxi to invade the southern capital region; Ne'ergeng'e's army was routed at Linming Pass, and Longping and Baixiang fell in succession.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the rebels advanced from Shanxi into the southern capital region. Ne'ergeng'e's army was routed at Linming Pass, and Longping and Baixiang fell one after another.

sentences.zh: 訥爾經額褫職逮治，授桂良直隸總督，詔責偕都統勝保速籌防剿。

translations.literal: Ne'ergeng'e was stripped of office and arrested for trial; Gui Liang was appointed governor-general of Zhili, and an edict charged him together with commandant Sheng Bao to plan defense and suppression swiftly.
translations.idiomatic: Ne'ergeng'e was dismissed and arrested; Gui Liang was made governor-general of Zhili and ordered, together with commandant Sheng Bao, to organize defense and suppression at once.

sentences.zh: 布政使張集馨出兵遷延，劾罷之。

translations.literal: The provincial administration commissioner Zhang Jixin delayed in sending troops; Gui Liang impeached and dismissed him.
translations.idiomatic: When administration commissioner Zhang Jixin delayed sending troops, Gui Liang impeached him and had him removed.

sentences.zh: 賊竄正定、定州、深州、河間、天津，勢剽甚，於是桂良率提督張殿元守保定，科爾沁郡王僧格林沁統大兵駐通州衛京師，勝保督師進剿。

translations.literal: The rebels fled through Zhengding, Dingzhou, Shenzhou, Hejian, and Tianjin; their momentum was extremely fierce. Thereupon Gui Liang led provincial military commissioner Zhang Dianyuan to hold Baoding, the Khorchin prince Sengge Rinchen commanded the main army stationed at Tongzhou to guard the capital, and Sheng Bao directed the army in pursuit and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels swept through Zhengding, Dingzhou, Shenzhou, Hejian, and Tianjin with ferocious momentum. Gui Liang then held Baoding with provincial military commissioner Zhang Dianyuan, Khorchin Prince Sengge Rinchen massed his main force at Tongzhou to shield the capital, and Sheng Bao led the pursuit.

sentences.zh: 四年，大捷於獨流鎮，賊走踞阜城，又走連鎮，僧格林沁、勝保會攻，賊分竄山東，勝保追擊之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, a great victory was won at Duliuzhen; the rebels fled and occupied Fucheng, then fled again to Lianzhen. Sengge Rinchen and Sheng Bao joined in attack; the rebels split and fled into Shandong, and Sheng Bao pursued them.
translations.idiomatic: In 1854 a major victory was won at Duliuzhen. The rebels withdrew to Fucheng, then to Lianzhen. Sengge Rinchen and Sheng Bao attacked together; when the rebels split and fled into Shandong, Sheng Bao pursued them.

sentences.zh: 桂良遣張殿元赴武邑防堵，劾散秩大臣穆輅、健銳營翼長雙僖縱兵傷官擾民，議譴。

translations.literal: Gui Liang sent Zhang Dianyuan to Wuyi for blocking defense, and impeached the minister without regular rank Mu Lu and the Vanguard Brigade wing commander Shuang Xi for letting their troops injure officials and harass the people; censure was deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Liang sent Zhang Dianyuan to block the rebels at Wuyi and impeached minister without regular rank Mu Lu and Vanguard Brigade wing commander Shuang Xi for allowing their troops to wound officials and harass civilians; the court deliberated punishment.

sentences.zh: 秋，英吉利、美利堅兩國兵船至大沽。

translations.literal: In autumn, warships of England and the United States arrived at Dagu.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn British and American warships arrived at Dagu.

sentences.zh: 時賊氛未靖，詔戒張皇，命桂良相機辦理。

translations.literal: At the time the rebel situation was not yet settled; an edict warned against alarm and ordered Gui Liang to handle matters as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel unrest had not yet subsided, and the court warned against panic while ordering Gui Liang to handle the foreign crisis as circumstances allowed.

sentences.zh: 尋以前任鹽政崇綸歸調遣，令赴天津會議。

translations.literal: Soon afterward the former salt commissioner Chonglun was recalled to his command and ordered to go to Tianjin for negotiations.
translations.idiomatic: Chonglun, the former salt commissioner, was soon recalled and ordered to Tianjin to join the talks.

sentences.zh: 英酋咆呤要索十六條，欲遣官駐京及踐廣州入城之約，中外官平禮接見，通商稅則變通舊約；

translations.literal: The British chief Bowring demanded sixteen articles, wishing to dispatch officials to reside in the capital and fulfill the agreement on entry into Guangzhou, equal ceremonial reception between Chinese and foreign officials, and revision of commercial tax regulations under the old treaties;
translations.idiomatic: The British plenipotentiary Bowring pressed sixteen demands, including resident ministers in Beijing, fulfillment of the Guangzhou entry agreement, equal ceremonial status for Chinese and foreign officials, and revision of commercial tariffs under existing treaties;

sentences.zh: 美酋麥蓮則僅言通商一端。

translations.literal: The American chief Reed spoke only of the matter of trade.
translations.idiomatic: The American envoy Reed raised only trade issues.

sentences.zh: 崇綸等嚴拒其駐京，餘事令赴廣東聽總督查辦。

translations.literal: Chonglun and others sternly refused their residence in the capital; on other matters they were told to go to Guangdong and await handling by the governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Chonglun and his colleagues firmly refused resident ministers in Beijing and referred other matters to the governor-general of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 屢議無要領，咆呤等尋去。

translations.literal: Repeated negotiations produced no essentials; Bowring and the others soon departed.
translations.idiomatic: Talks dragged on without result, and Bowring and his party soon left.

sentences.zh: 五年，僧格林沁連大破賊，賊首林鳳祥、李開芳先後就擒伏誅，畿輔肅清。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Sengge Rinchen won successive great victories over the rebels; the rebel leaders Lin Fengxiang and Li Kaifang were captured in turn and executed, and the capital region was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In 1855 Sengge Rinchen inflicted a series of crushing defeats on the rebels. Lin Fengxiang and Li Kaifang were captured and executed in turn, and the capital region was cleared.

sentences.zh: 七年，召拜東閣大學士，管理刑部，兼正藍旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he was summoned and appointed Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion, placed in charge of the Ministry of Punishments, and concurrently made commandant of the Mongol Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In 1857 he was summoned as Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion, placed in charge of the Ministry of Punishments, and made concurrent commandant of the Mongol Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 八年春，英、法、俄、美四國聯軍北犯，毀大沽砲台，泊天津城下，聲言將犯京師。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eighth year, the allied armies of Britain, France, Russia, and the United States invaded northward, destroyed the Dagu batteries, anchored below Tianjin, and declared they would attack the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of 1858 the allied forces of Britain, France, Russia, and the United States advanced north, destroyed the Dagu forts, anchored off Tianjin, and threatened to march on Beijing.

sentences.zh: 倉猝援軍未集，命桂良偕尚書花沙納往議。

translations.literal: Relief troops had not yet assembled in the emergency; Gui Liang was ordered to go with Minister Hua Shana to negotiate.
translations.idiomatic: Relief troops had not yet gathered, and Gui Liang was sent with Minister Hua Shana to negotiate.

sentences.zh: 敵情猖肆，要求益多：以遣官駐京、內江通商、內地遊行、兵費賠償後，始交還廣東省城。

translations.literal: The enemy's conduct was wildly aggressive and their demands grew: only after dispatch of resident officials to the capital, inland-river trade, inland travel, and payment of military indemnity would they return Guangzhou city.
translations.idiomatic: The allies grew more aggressive and their demands multiplied: they would return Guangzhou only after resident ministers in Beijing, inland navigation and trade, inland travel rights, and payment of war indemnity.

sentences.zh: 四事廷議不允。

translations.literal: The court deliberated and would not agree to the four matters.
translations.idiomatic: The court refused all four demands.

sentences.zh: 復起故大學士耆英同與議，英人尤不悅，拒之，耆英以擅回京獲罪。

translations.literal: The former Grand Secretary Qiying was again raised to negotiate together with them; the British were especially displeased and rejected him; Qiying was punished for returning to the capital without authorization.
translations.idiomatic: Former Grand Secretary Qiying was brought back to join the talks, but the British especially disliked him and refused to deal with him. Qiying was punished for returning to Beijing without leave.

sentences.zh: 桂良等議久不決，廷臣多主戰，實不足恃，而敵日以進兵為恐哧。

translations.literal: Gui Liang and the others deliberated long without decision; many court officials favored war, but in reality that could not be relied upon, while the enemy daily used advancing troops as intimidation.
translations.idiomatic: Negotiations dragged on without resolution. Many officials urged war, but that was no real option, while the allies daily threatened to advance their armies.

sentences.zh: 俄、美兩國調停其間，卒徇所請定議，而通商稅則俟於上海詳定之。

translations.literal: Russia and the United States mediated between them; in the end the requests were followed and an agreement settled, while commercial tax regulations were to await detailed settlement at Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: Russia and the United States mediated, and the court finally accepted the allied demands, leaving commercial tariffs to be worked out in detail at Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 五月，簽約退兵，遂命桂良偕花沙納赴上海，武備院卿明善、刑部員外郎段承實副之，會同兩江總督何桂清議稅則。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, treaties were signed and the troops withdrew; Gui Liang was then ordered to go with Hua Shana to Shanghai, with Vice Minister of the Armory Bureau Ming Shan and Ministry of Punishments vice director Duan Chengshi as deputies, to confer with Liangjiang governor-general He Guiqing on tax regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In May the treaties were signed and the allies withdrew. Gui Liang was sent with Hua Shana to Shanghai, accompanied by Ming Shan and Duan Chengshi, to negotiate tariffs with Liangjiang governor-general He Guiqing.

sentences.zh: 文宗憤和約之成出於不得已，或獻策許全免入口稅以市惠，冀改易駐京諸條，密授桂良等機宜。

translations.literal: The Xianfeng Emperor was angry that the treaty had been concluded from necessity; some proposed granting complete exemption from import duties to win favor, hoping to alter the articles on residence in the capital, and secretly gave Gui Liang and the others confidential instructions.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xianfeng resented that the treaty had been forced on the court. Some advisers suggested offering full exemption from import duties to win concessions on resident ministers, and secretly briefed Gui Liang on how to proceed.

sentences.zh: 八月，至上海，晉文華殿大學士，授內大臣。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, he reached Shanghai, was promoted to Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Glory, and appointed inner court minister.
translations.idiomatic: In August he reached Shanghai, was promoted to Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Glory, and made an inner court minister.

sentences.zh: 桂清力言免稅之不可，改約之難成，桂良亦贊其議，上甚怒，必責其補救一二端，而各國因廣東民團仍與為難，且出示偽載諭旨，堅欲罷兩廣總督黃宗漢，停撤民團。

translations.literal: He Guiqing strongly argued that tax exemption was impossible and treaty revision hard to achieve; Gui Liang also endorsed his view. The emperor was very angry and insisted they remedy at least one or two points. Meanwhile the various powers, because Guangdong militia still clashed with them and even produced a forged imperial edict, firmly demanded dismissal of Liangguang governor-general Huang Zonghan and a halt to disbanding the militia.
translations.idiomatic: He Guiqing argued forcefully that tax exemption was impossible and treaty revision unlikely; Gui Liang agreed. The emperor was furious and demanded they salvage something from the talks. Meanwhile the foreign powers, citing continuing clashes with Guangdong militia and even a forged imperial edict, insisted on removing Huang Zonghan as governor-general and stopping the disbandment of militia forces.

sentences.zh: 桂良等疏聞，乃解宗漢通商大臣，改授桂清。

translations.literal: Gui Liang and the others memorialized reporting this; Huang Zonghan was then removed as commissioner for trade and He Guiqing was appointed in his place.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Liang reported the situation to court, and Huang Zonghan was removed as trade commissioner in favor of He Guiqing.

sentences.zh: 桂良等噤不敢言罷駐京諸事，先議稅則。

translations.literal: Gui Liang and the others fell silent and dared not speak of abolishing the matters of residence in the capital; they first discussed tax regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Liang and his colleagues dared not raise abolition of resident ministers and turned first to tariff negotiations.

sentences.zh: 十二月，英使額羅金遽率兵船赴廣東，遂罷議。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the British envoy Elgin suddenly led warships to Guangdong, and negotiations were therefore suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In December the British envoy Elgin suddenly sailed for Guangdong with his fleet, and the tariff talks were broken off.

sentences.zh: 九年，回京，僅美利堅一國遵換通商之約，英軍复犯大沽，僧格林沁預設備，兵至，擊退之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he returned to the capital; only the United States followed the treaty on exchanging commercial agreements. British forces again invaded Dagu; Sengge Rinchen had made preparations in advance, and when the troops arrived, they were repelled.
translations.idiomatic: In 1859 he returned to Beijing. Only the United States exchanged the commercial treaty. When British forces again attacked Dagu, Sengge Rinchen was ready and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 十年，英法聯軍大舉來犯，我師失利。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, the British-French allied armies came in force; our armies were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In 1860 the Anglo-French allies invaded in force and Qing forces were defeated.

sentences.zh: 七月，復命桂良赴天津議和，要增兵費，入京換約，嚴詔拒絕。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Gui Liang was again ordered to Tianjin to negotiate peace; they demanded increased military indemnity and exchange of treaties in the capital, but stern edicts refused.
translations.idiomatic: In July Gui Liang was again sent to Tianjin to negotiate. The allies demanded higher indemnity and treaty exchange in Beijing, but the court issued strict orders to refuse.

sentences.zh: 敵陷天津，進逼京師，上幸熱河，恭親王奕訢留守主撫議，桂良與焉。

translations.literal: The enemy captured Tianjin and advanced on the capital; the emperor went to Rehe; Prince Gong Yixin remained to oversee pacification negotiations, and Gui Liang took part.
translations.idiomatic: The allies took Tianjin and advanced on Beijing. The emperor fled to Rehe while Prince Gong Yixin remained to handle peace talks, with Gui Liang among the negotiators.

sentences.zh: 九月，於禮部換約，視八年原議益增條款，事具邦交志。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, treaties were exchanged at the Ministry of Rites; compared with the original agreement of the eighth year, the articles were further increased. The matter is recorded in full in the Treaties section.
translations.idiomatic: In September the treaties were exchanged at the Ministry of Rites with more onerous terms than the 1858 agreement. Details are given in the Treaties section.

sentences.zh: 尋命督辦各國通商事務。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was ordered to supervise the commercial affairs of the various nations.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed to supervise foreign trade affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一年，穆宗即位，回京，命在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, the Muzong Emperor ascended the throne; Gui Liang returned to the capital and was ordered to serve on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In 1861, after the Tongzhi Emperor's accession, Gui Liang returned to Beijing and was appointed to the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，卒，優恤，贈太傅，祀賢良祠，諡文端。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, he died; generous condolence gifts were granted, he was posthumously made Grand Tutor, enshrined in the Shrine of Worthy Officials, and given the posthumous title Wenduan.
translations.idiomatic: He died in 1862. The court granted generous mourning honors, posthumously made him Grand Tutor, enshrined him in the Shrine of Worthy Officials, and gave him the posthumous title Wenduan.

sentences.zh: 瑞麟，字澄泉，葉赫那喇氏，滿洲正藍旗人。

translations.literal: Rui Lin, courtesy name Chengquan, of the Yehe Nara clan, was a man of the Manchu Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Rui Lin, whose courtesy name was Chengquan, belonged to the Yehe Nara clan of the Manchu Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 由文生充太常寺讀祝官，補贊禮郎。

translations.literal: From the ranks of literary licentiates he served as prayer reader of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and was appointed ritual attendant.
translations.idiomatic: A literary licentiate, he served as prayer reader at the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and was later appointed ritual attendant.

sentences.zh: 道光二十七年，祫祭太廟，讀祝洪亮，宣宗嘉之，賜五品頂戴、花翎。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Daoguang, at the joint autumn sacrifice in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, his reading of the prayer was resonant; the Xuanzong Emperor praised him and granted a fifth-rank official cap button and peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In 1847, at the autumn joint sacrifice in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, his prayer reading was so resonant that Emperor Daoguang praised him and granted a fifth-rank cap button and peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，超擢太常寺少卿，又擢內閣學士，兼管太常寺。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, he was exceptionally promoted to vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, then promoted to Grand Secretariat academician and placed concurrently in charge of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In 1848 he was rapidly promoted to vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, then to Grand Secretariat academician with concurrent charge of that court.

sentences.zh: 三十年，擢禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, he was promoted to vice minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In 1850 he was promoted to vice minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，兼鑲藍旗滿洲副都統、正黃旗護軍統領。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng, he concurrently served as vice commandant of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner and commandant of the Plain Yellow Banner Guards.
translations.idiomatic: In 1851 he also served as vice commandant of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner and commandant of the Plain Yellow Banner Guards.

sentences.zh: 三年，調戶部，命在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: In the third year, he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue and ordered to serve on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In 1853 he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue and appointed to the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 時粵匪竄畿輔，踞靜海縣及獨流鎮，命瑞麟率兵從僧格林沁防剿，會攻獨流，克之。

translations.literal: At the time the Cantonese rebels had fled into the capital region and occupied Jinghai county and Duliuzhen; Rui Lin was ordered to lead troops following Sengge Rinchen in defense and suppression, joined in attacking Duliuzhen, and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: When Taiping rebels entered the capital region and held Jinghai and Duliuzhen, Rui Lin was ordered to join Sengge Rinchen in suppressing them. They attacked Duliuzhen together and took it.

sentences.zh: 靜海賊竄陷阜城，又分竄連鎮及山東高唐州，瑞麟合擊，屢有擒斬。

translations.literal: The Jinghai rebels fled and captured Fucheng, then split and fled to Lianzhen and Gaotang prefecture in Shandong; Rui Lin joined in attacks and repeatedly captured and executed rebels.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled from Jinghai, took Fucheng, and split toward Lianzhen and Gaotang in Shandong. Rui Lin joined the pursuit and repeatedly captured and executed enemy fighters.

sentences.zh: 五年，克連鎮，賊首林鳳祥就擒，加都統銜，賜號巴達瑯阿巴圖魯，授西安將軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Lianzhen was captured and the rebel leader Lin Fengxiang was taken; Rui Lin was given the rank of commandant, granted the title Badarang Abaturu, and appointed general of Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: In 1855 Lianzhen fell and Lin Fengxiang was captured. Rui Lin was given commandant rank, honored with the title Badarang Abaturu, and appointed general of Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 未幾，擢禮部尚書，兼鑲白旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Before long he was promoted to minister of Rites and concurrently made commandant of the Mongol Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to minister of Rites and made concurrent commandant of the Mongol Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 八年，英兵犯天津，命馳赴楊村籌防。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, British troops invaded Tianjin; he was ordered to hurry to Yangcun to organize defense.
translations.idiomatic: In 1858, when British forces threatened Tianjin, he was ordered to rush to Yangcun to organize defenses.

sentences.zh: 洎撫議定，敵退。

translations.literal: When pacification negotiations were settled, the enemy withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: After peace was negotiated, the enemy withdrew.

sentences.zh: 文宗知和不可恃，亟治海防，命瑞麟赴天津修築大沽砲台。

translations.literal: The Xianfeng Emperor knew peace could not be relied upon and urgently strengthened coastal defense; Rui Lin was ordered to Tianjin to repair and build the Dagu batteries.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing peace could not be trusted, Emperor Xianfeng urgently strengthened coastal defenses and ordered Rui Lin to Tianjin to rebuild the Dagu forts.

sentences.zh: 尋署直隸總督，增建雙港砲台，調福建霆船戰船，增募水師。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he served as acting governor-general of Zhili, added batteries at Shuanggang, transferred Fujian thunder-boat warships, and increased recruitment of naval forces.
translations.idiomatic: He soon served as acting governor-general of Zhili, built additional batteries at Shuanggang, transferred Fujian warships, and expanded the navy.

sentences.zh: 僧格林沁移師天津，分駐要隘。

translations.literal: Sengge Rinchen moved his army to Tianjin and stationed detachments at key passes.
translations.idiomatic: Sengge Rinchen moved his forces to Tianjin and posted detachments at strategic points.

sentences.zh: 瑞麟回京，調戶部尚書緦拜文淵閣大學士，兼管禮部鴻臚寺、太常寺。

translations.literal: Rui Lin returned to the capital, was transferred to minister of Revenue, and was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Depths, concurrently managing the Ministry of Rites, Court of State Ceremonial, and Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Rui Lin returned to Beijing, became minister of Revenue, and was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Depths with concurrent charge of the Ministry of Rites, Court of State Ceremonial, and Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 九年，管理戶部。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he managed the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In 1859 he took charge of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十年，充殿試讀卷官，授內大臣。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, he served as examiner of palace examination papers and was appointed inner court minister.
translations.idiomatic: In 1860 he served as examiner of palace examination papers and was made an inner court minister.

sentences.zh: 六月，英法聯軍复犯天津，命率京兵萬人守通州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the British-French allied armies again invaded Tianjin; he was ordered to lead ten thousand capital troops to guard Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In June the Anglo-French allies again attacked Tianjin, and he was ordered to hold Tongzhou with ten thousand capital troops.

sentences.zh: 僧格林沁屢戰失利，敵軍進通州，瑞麟偕勝保御之八里橋，左右夾擊，勝保傷砲墜馬，軍潰，敵遂逼京師。

translations.literal: Sengge Rinchen suffered repeated defeats; the enemy army advanced on Tongzhou. Rui Lin together with Sheng Bao defended at Baliqiao with attacks from both flanks; Sheng Bao was wounded by cannon fire and fell from his horse, the army was routed, and the enemy then pressed on the capital.
translations.idiomatic: After Sengge Rinchen's repeated defeats, the enemy advanced on Tongzhou. Rui Lin and Sheng Bao defended Bali Bridge with a pincer attack, but Sheng Bao was wounded by cannon fire and fell from his horse. The army collapsed and the enemy pressed toward Beijing.

sentences.zh: 瑞麟迎戰安定門外，敗績，褫職。

translations.literal: Rui Lin met the enemy outside the Anding Gate, was defeated, and was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Rui Lin fought the enemy outside the Anding Gate, was defeated, and dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 車駕幸熱河，命扈從行在。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage went to Rehe; he was ordered to accompany the traveling court.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor fled to Rehe, Rui Lin was ordered to accompany the traveling court.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，和議成，予侍郎銜，隨僧格林沁剿山東捻匪。

translations.literal: That winter peace was concluded; he was given the rank of vice minister and followed Sengge Rinchen to suppress the Nian bandits in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, after peace was concluded, he was given vice-minister rank and joined Sengge Rinchen in suppressing the Nian rebels in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 攻鉅野羊山集賊巢，失利，馬蹶被傷，退軍濟寧，复褫職，召回京。

translations.literal: Attacking the rebel nest at Yangshanji in Juye, he was defeated; his horse stumbled and he was injured; the army withdrew to Jining; he was again stripped of office and recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: An attack on the rebel stronghold at Yangshanji in Juye failed. His horse stumbled and he was wounded. The army withdrew to Jining, he was dismissed again, and recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 十一年，授鑲黃旗漢軍都統，管神機營事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, he was appointed commandant of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner Chinese Brigade and placed in charge of the Firearms Division.
translations.idiomatic: In 1861 he was appointed commandant of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner Chinese Brigade and placed in charge of the Firearms Division.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，出為熱河都統，疏請招佃圍邊荒地八千頃充練餉，允之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, he went out as commandant of Rehe and memorialized requesting recruitment of tenants for eight thousand qing of wasteland on the border enclosures to supply drill funds; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In 1862 he was posted as commandant of Rehe and memorialized to lease eight thousand qing of border wasteland for drill funds; the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 二年，調廣州將軍。

translations.literal: In the second year, he was transferred as general of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1863 he was transferred to serve as general of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 四年，兼署兩廣總督。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he concurrently served as acting governor-general of Liangguang.
translations.idiomatic: In 1865 he also served as acting governor-general of Liangguang.

sentences.zh: 信宜、化州土匪起，遣兵平之。

translations.literal: Bandits rose in Xinyi and Huazhou; he dispatched troops and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits rose in Xinyi and Huazhou, he sent troops to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 粵匪汪海洋由福建竄廣東大埔，遣副將方耀擊走之。

translations.literal: The Cantonese rebel Wang Haiyang fled from Fujian into Dabu in Guangdong; the deputy commander Fang Yao was dispatched and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebel Wang Haiyang fled from Fujian into Dabu, Guangdong, Rui Lin sent deputy commander Fang Yao to drive him back.

sentences.zh: 入閩會剿，复詔安、平和。

translations.literal: He entered Fujian for joint suppression and recovered Zhao'an and Pinghe.
translations.idiomatic: He crossed into Fujian for joint operations and recovered Zhao'an and Pinghe.

sentences.zh: 賊复竄廣東境，連敗之於長樂、鎮平。

translations.literal: The rebels again fled into Guangdong territory and were repeatedly defeated at Changle and Zhenping.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels again entered Guangdong and were repeatedly defeated at Changle and Zhenping.

sentences.zh: 時賊踪往來於福建、廣東、江西界上，瑞麟偕左宗棠疏請三省會剿。

translations.literal: At the time rebel tracks moved back and forth along the borders of Fujian, Guangdong, and Jiangxi; Rui Lin together with Zuo Zongtang memorialized requesting joint suppression by the three provinces.
translations.idiomatic: As rebels moved along the Fujian-Guangdong-Jiangxi border, Rui Lin and Zuo Zongtang memorialized for a three-province joint campaign.

sentences.zh: 詔提督鮑超由江西來援，四面環攻。

translations.literal: An edict ordered provincial military commissioner Bao Chao to come from Jiangxi in support, with attacks from all four sides encircling them.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered provincial military commissioner Bao Chao to advance from Jiangxi, and the allies surrounded the rebels on all sides.

sentences.zh: 十二月，殲偽偕王譚體元於黃沙壩，擒首逆汪海洋，誅之，餘賊肅清。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the false co-king Tan Tiyuan was destroyed at Huangshaba, the chief rebel Wang Haiyang was captured and executed, and the remaining rebels were cleared.
translations.idiomatic: In December the false co-king Tan Tiyuan was destroyed at Huangshaba, Wang Haiyang was captured and executed, and the remaining rebels were eliminated.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，優詔嘉獎。

translations.literal: When news of the victory arrived, an edict of special praise and reward was issued.
translations.idiomatic: On news of the victory, the court issued a commendatory edict.

sentences.zh: 五年，實授兩廣總督。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he was formally appointed governor-general of Liangguang.
translations.idiomatic: In 1866 he was formally appointed governor-general of Liangguang.

sentences.zh: 廣東素多盜，伏莽時起。

translations.literal: Guangdong had always had many bandits, and hidden brigands rose from time to time.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong had long been plagued by bandits, with outlaw bands rising from time to time.

sentences.zh: 時巡撫蔣益澧號知兵，瑞麟部將方耀、鄭紹忠皆能戰，先後破斬五坑客匪，曹沖、赤溪及新安、東莞諸匪，潮州、瓊州洋盜、土匪。

translations.literal: At the time the governor Jiang Yizao was known as skilled in military affairs; Rui Lin's subordinate generals Fang Yao and Zheng Shaozhong were all capable fighters. They successively defeated and killed the Hakka bandits of Wukeng, bandits of Caochong, Chixi, and those of Xin'an and Dongguan, as well as foreign pirates and local bandits of Chaozhou and Qiongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Jiang Yizao was known as a capable military man, and Rui Lin's generals Fang Yao and Zheng Shaozhong were skilled fighters. They successively defeated the Wukeng Hakka bandits, outlaws in Caochong and Chixi, gangs in Xin'an and Dongguan, and pirates and bandits in Chaozhou and Qiongzhou.

sentences.zh: 九年，兼署巡撫。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he concurrently served as acting governor.
translations.idiomatic: In 1870 he also served concurrently as acting governor.

sentences.zh: 十年，復拜文淵閣大學士，仍留總督任。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, he was again appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Depths and remained in the governor-general's post.
translations.idiomatic: In 1871 he was again made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Depths while retaining the governorship.

sentences.zh: 十三年，卒，詔嘉前勞，贈太保，祀賢良祠，諡文莊。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, he died; an edict praised his former labors, he was posthumously made Grand Guardian, enshrined in the Shrine of Worthy Officials, and given the posthumous title Wenzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: He died in 1874. The court praised his past service, posthumously made him Grand Guardian, enshrined him in the Shrine of Worthy Officials, and gave him the posthumous title Wenzhuang.

sentences.zh: 子懷塔布，由廕生授刑部主事，晉員外郎。

translations.literal: His son Huai Tabu, through hereditary privilege, was appointed secretary in the Ministry of Punishments and promoted to vice director.
translations.idiomatic: His son Huai Tabu entered service through hereditary privilege as a secretary in the Ministry of Punishments and was promoted to vice director.

sentences.zh: 以父卹典擢四品京堂，累遷禮部尚書，充內務府大臣。

translations.literal: On account of his father's mourning honors he was promoted to a fourth-rank capital official, successively rose to minister of Rites, and served as minister of the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: Through his father's mourning honors he rose to a fourth-rank capital post, became minister of Rites, and served on the Imperial Household.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十四年，主事王照上書言事，久之始代奏，坐違旨抑格，褫職。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu, secretary Wang Zhao submitted a memorial on state affairs; only after a long delay did Huai Tabu present it on his behalf. He was punished for violating the imperial will and suppressing the memorial, and was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1898 secretary Wang Zhao submitted a reform memorial that Huai Tabu delayed presenting for a long time. He was dismissed for defying the throne and suppressing the memorial.

sentences.zh: 未幾，皇太后訓政，起授左都御史，复充​​內務府大臣，遷理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: Before long the Empress Dowager resumed regency; he was raised and appointed left censor-in-chief, again served as minister of the Imperial Household, and was transferred to minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, when the Empress Dowager resumed regency, he was restored as left censor-in-chief, again made minister of the Imperial Household, and transferred to minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，卒，贈太子少保，諡恪勤。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, he died; he was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous title Keqin.
translations.idiomatic: He died in 1900 and was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous title Keqin.

sentences.zh: 官文，字秀峰，王佳氏，滿洲正白旗人，先隸內務府正白旗漢軍。

translations.literal: Guan Wen, courtesy name Xiufeng, of the Wangjia clan, was a man of the Manchu Plain White Banner and had earlier been attached to the Plain White Banner Chinese Brigade of the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen, whose courtesy name was Xiufeng, belonged to the Wangjia clan of the Manchu Plain White Banner and had earlier been attached to the Plain White Banner Chinese Brigade of the Imperial Household.

sentences.zh: 由拜唐阿補藍翎侍衛，累擢頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: From the rank of attendant he was appointed blue-lance bodyguard and was repeatedly promoted to first-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as an attendant, he became a blue-lance bodyguard and was repeatedly promoted to first-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 道光二十一年，出為廣州漢軍副都統，調荊州右翼副都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Daoguang, he went out as vice commandant of the Guangzhou Chinese Brigade and was transferred as vice commandant of the Jingzhou Right Wing.
translations.idiomatic: In 1841 he was posted as vice commandant of the Guangzhou Chinese Brigade and later transferred to the Jingzhou Right Wing.

sentences.zh: 粵匪既陷漢陽，將犯荊州。

translations.literal: After the Cantonese rebels had captured Hanyang, they were about to invade Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After the Taiping rebels took Hanyang, they were poised to strike Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，將軍台湧駐防德安，命官文專統荊州防兵。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng, General Tai Yong garrisoned De'an; Guan Wen was ordered to take sole command of the Jingzhou defense troops.
translations.idiomatic: In 1853 General Tai Yong garrisoned De'an while Guan Wen was placed in sole command of Jingzhou's defense forces.

sentences.zh: 四年，擢荊州將軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he was promoted to general of Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1854 he was promoted to general of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 賊陷安陸、荊門、宜昌。

translations.literal: The rebels captured Anlu, Jingmen, and Yichang.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels captured Anlu, Jingmen, and Yichang.

sentences.zh: 時荊州兵多調赴武昌，分屯要隘，城中兵僅二千。

translations.literal: At the time most Jingzhou troops had been transferred to Wuchang and were posted at key passes; troops in the city numbered only two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Most Jingzhou troops had been sent to Wuchang and posted at key passes, leaving only two thousand men in the city.

sentences.zh: 監利又陷，官文遣軍復之；

translations.literal: Jianli fell again; Guan Wen dispatched troops and recovered it;
translations.idiomatic: When Jianli fell again, Guan Wen sent troops to recover it;

sentences.zh: 連复宜昌、石首、華容，於是荊州稍安，而武昌被圍急，官文遣將沿漢下援。

translations.literal: He successively recovered Yichang, Shishou, and Huarong; Jingzhou was thus somewhat settled, but Wuchang was under urgent siege, and Guan Wen sent generals down the Han to reinforce.
translations.idiomatic: He then recovered Yichang, Shishou, and Huarong, easing pressure on Jingzhou, but as Wuchang came under heavy siege he sent generals down the Han to reinforce.

sentences.zh: 六月，武昌复失守，命官文統籌全局，規复武漢。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Wuchang again fell; Guan Wen was ordered to coordinate the overall situation and plan recovery of Wuhan.
translations.idiomatic: In June Wuchang fell again, and Guan Wen was ordered to coordinate the overall campaign to recover Wuhan.

sentences.zh: 因疏言：「賊情詭譎，軍情隨時變幻。

translations.literal: He therefore memorialized, saying: "The rebels' situation is treacherous and shifting, and military circumstances change from moment to moment.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "The rebels are treacherous and unpredictable, and the military situation changes by the day.

sentences.zh: 武漢之賊一日不盡，荊州不得安枕。

translations.literal: So long as the rebels at Wuhan are not eliminated in a single day, Jingzhou cannot rest secure.
translations.idiomatic: Until the rebels at Wuhan are destroyed, Jingzhou cannot be secure.

sentences.zh: 賊踞漢陽，倚江為險，絕我糧道，阻我援軍。

translations.literal: The rebels hold Hanyang, relying on the river as a strategic barrier, cutting off our grain routes and blocking our relief armies.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels hold Hanyang, using the river as a barrier to cut our supply lines and block our reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 今欲复武昌，必先攻漢陽，奪賊所恃之險，而後武昌可圖也。

translations.literal: If we now wish to recover Wuchang, we must first attack Hanyang and seize the strategic barrier on which the rebels rely; only then can Wuchang be contemplated.
translations.idiomatic: To recover Wuchang we must first take Hanyang and seize the river barrier the rebels rely on; only then can Wuchang be retaken.

sentences.zh: 總兵雙保自潛江進剿，兵力過單。

translations.literal: Provincial military commissioner Shuang Bao advances from Qianjiang in pursuit and suppression, but his force is too weak alone.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial military commissioner Shuang Bao is advancing from Qianjiang, but his force is too weak alone.

sentences.zh: 臣已令羅遵殿以戰船百艘自仙桃鎮、蔡店迳趨漢陽，與撫臣楊霈分道夾攻；

translations.literal: Your subject has already ordered Luo Zundian with a hundred war junks to strike directly at Hanyang from Xiantao and Caidian, attacking from separate routes together with Governor Yang Pei;
translations.idiomatic: I have ordered Luo Zundian with a hundred war junks to strike Hanyang directly from Xiantao and Caidian, while Governor Yang Pei attacks from another route;

sentences.zh: 又檄總兵福炘往助雙保，知縣吳振鏞進复沔陽以通餉道。

translations.literal: I have also ordered provincial military commissioner Fu Xin to assist Shuang Bao, and magistrate Wu Zhenyong to advance and recover Mianyang to open the supply route.
translations.idiomatic: I have also ordered Fu Xin to reinforce Shuang Bao and magistrate Wu Zhenyong to recover Mianyang and reopen the supply route.

sentences.zh: 惟賊踞岳州，南北援軍均受牽制，尤應先剿岳州之賊。

translations.literal: But the rebels hold Yuezhou, and relief armies north and south are both constrained; we should especially first suppress the rebels at Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: With rebels holding Yuezhou and tying down forces north and south, we should first clear Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓方統砲船駐湘陰，塔齊布之師已入岳州境，臣已促其速進，分兵阻江路。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan is now commanding gunboats stationed at Xiangyin; Taqibu's army has already entered Yuezhou territory; your subject has urged them to advance swiftly and divide troops to block the river route.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan commands gunboats at Xiangyin and Taqibu's army has entered Yuezhou. I have urged them to advance quickly and block the river route.

sentences.zh: 复派同知銜李光榮等率川勇防調弦口，張子銘防監利尺八口，都司宗維清沿江接應。

translations.literal: I have also dispatched sub-prefect Li Guangrong and others leading Sichuan braves to defend Diaoxiankou, Zhang Ziming to defend Chibakou in Jianli, and battalion commander Zong Weiqing to respond along the river.
translations.idiomatic: I have also posted Li Guangrong's Sichuan braves at Diaoxiankou, Zhang Ziming at Chibakou in Jianli, and battalion commander Zong Weiqing along the river line.

sentences.zh: 荊州僅賸旗兵分守要隘，隨時接應，庶幾可進可退，不致有顧此失彼之虞。

translations.literal: At Jingzhou only banner troops remain, posted at key passes to respond at any time, so that we may advance or withdraw and not fear losing one place while grasping another.
translations.idiomatic: At Jingzhou only banner troops remain at key passes for support, so we can advance or withdraw without neglecting one front for another.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，報聞。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, acknowledgment was returned.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was received and noted.

sentences.zh: 尋曾國籓克岳州，賊艘悉出大江，官文遣涼州副都統魁玉、總兵楊昌泗赴螺山防江，殲賊甚多。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Zeng Guofan captured Yuezhou; rebel vessels all came out onto the great river. Guan Wen dispatched Liangzhou vice commandant Kui Yu and provincial military commissioner Yang Changsi to Luoshan to defend the river and destroyed many rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Zeng Guofan took Yuezhou and rebel vessels poured into the main river. Guan Wen sent Kui Yu and Yang Changsi to Luoshan to block the river and destroyed many rebels.

sentences.zh: 八月，武昌、漢陽相繼复，論功被優敘。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Wuchang and Hanyang were recovered in succession; for merit he received preferential commendation.
translations.idiomatic: In August Wuchang and Hanyang were recovered in turn, and he received special commendation for merit.

sentences.zh: 五年，總督楊霈師潰德安，漢陽、漢口復陷，德安、隨州繼之，詔褫霈職，授官文湖廣總督。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Governor Yang Pei's army was routed at De'an; Hanyang and Hankou again fell, followed by De'an and Suizhou. An edict stripped Pei of office and appointed Guan Wen governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In 1855 Governor Yang Pei's army was routed at De'an. Hanyang and Hankou fell again, then De'an and Suizhou. Yang Pei was dismissed and Guan Wen made governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 師次安陸，疏言：「賊自隨州退踞德安，兇鋒疊挫。

translations.literal: The army halted at Anlu; he memorialized, saying: "The rebels withdrew from Suizhou and hold De'an; their fierce momentum has been repeatedly checked.
translations.idiomatic: Halting at Anlu, he memorialized: "The rebels withdrew from Suizhou to hold De'an, and their momentum has been checked repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 惟天門、京山道路四通，儻竄襄河，勾連仙桃鎮以下股匪，不獨荊襄在在堪虞，上游各處均可北竄。

translations.literal: But Tianmen and Jingshan have roads running in all four directions; if they flee into the Xiang River region and link with bandit groups below Xiantao, not only will Jingxiang be everywhere imperiled, but places upstream may all flee northward.
translations.idiomatic: But Tianmen and Jingshan have roads in all directions. If they slip into the Xiang River region and link with bandits below Xiantao, Jingxiang will be endangered and upstream areas may be overrun from the north.

sentences.zh: 現遣兵一由天門、皁市進剿，一往京山防守，臣駐安陸為兩路應援，諮固原提督孔廣順伺隙進取，署提臣訥欽為後應。

translations.literal: I now dispatch troops: one column from Tianmen and Zaoshi in pursuit and suppression, another to Jingshan for defense. Your subject stations at Anlu to support both routes, consults Guyuan provincial military commissioner Kong Guangshun to seize opportunities to advance, and acting provincial military commissioner Ne Qin serves as rear support.
translations.idiomatic: I am sending one column from Tianmen and Zaoshi in pursuit and another to defend Jingshan. I remain at Anlu to support both, while Kong Guangshun advances when opportunity allows and Ne Qin covers the rear.

sentences.zh: 俟欽差大臣西凌阿入楚，即統兵從襄河兩岸水陸並進，由漢川攻漢陽。

translations.literal: When Imperial Commissioner Xiling'a enters Chu, he will immediately command troops to advance by land and water along both banks of the Xiang River and attack Hanyang through Hanchuan.
translations.idiomatic: When Imperial Commissioner Xiling'a enters Hubei, we will advance by land and water along both banks of the Xiang and attack Hanyang through Hanchuan.

sentences.zh: 」秋，西凌阿戰德安失利，乃命官文代為欽差大臣，馳援德安。

translations.literal: " In autumn Xiling'a was defeated at De'an; Guan Wen was then ordered to replace him as Imperial Commissioner and hurry to reinforce De'an.
translations.idiomatic: " That autumn Xiling'a was defeated at De'an, and Guan Wen was made Imperial Commissioner in his place and rushed to reinforce De'an.

sentences.zh: 賊棄城走，躡追之，直搗漢陽。

translations.literal: The rebels abandoned the city and fled; he pursued them and drove straight at Hanyang.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels abandoned the city and fled; he pursued them straight to Hanyang.

sentences.zh: 十二月，督兵薄西門橋，迭敗賊於龜山、尾湖堤、五顯廟，破賊卡，毀東西土城。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, he directed troops to press on Ximen Bridge, repeatedly defeated rebels at Guishan, Weihudi, and Wuxian Temple, broke rebel stockades, and destroyed the eastern and western earthen walls.
translations.idiomatic: In December he pressed on Ximen Bridge, repeatedly defeated rebels at Guishan, Weihudi, and Wuxian Temple, broke their stockades, and destroyed the eastern and western earthen walls.

sentences.zh: 六年，賊造浮橋從西門分隊來犯，擊卻之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the rebels built a pontoon bridge and came to attack in separate columns from the west gate; they were repelled.
translations.idiomatic: In 1856 the rebels built a pontoon bridge and attacked in columns from the west gate; they were repelled.

sentences.zh: 分兵河口斷其糧道，令副都統都興阿攻圍風焚積聚，賊勢漸蹙。

translations.literal: He divided troops at the river mouth to cut their grain route, ordered vice commandant Du Xing'a to attack, besiege, and burn their stores by wind, and the rebel momentum gradually tightened.
translations.idiomatic: He posted troops at the river mouth to cut supply lines and ordered Du Xing'a to attack, besiege, and burn rebel stores, gradually tightening the rebel position.

sentences.zh: 秋，破漢陽城外賊營，連戰皆捷。

translations.literal: In autumn he broke the rebel camps outside Hanyang city; successive battles were all victorious.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he destroyed rebel camps outside Hanyang and won a series of victories.

sentences.zh: 巡撫胡林翼規复武昌。

translations.literal: Governor Hu Linyi planned recovery of Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Hu Linyi planned the recovery of Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 十一月，約同日水陸大舉，分攻武、漢，官文督軍分路進，水師擊漢陽東門，破五顯廟賊卡，李孟群又敗龜山援賊，王國才、楊昌泗由西門攻入，遂復漢陽，俘偽將軍等五百餘人。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, they agreed on a same-day major land-and-water assault, attacking Wuhan in separate columns. Guan Wen directed the army in separate advances; the naval force struck Hanyang's east gate and broke the Wuxian Temple stockade; Li Mengqun again defeated Guishan relief rebels; Wang Guocai and Yang Changsi entered through the west gate; Hanyang was thus recovered and more than five hundred false generals and others were captured.
translations.idiomatic: In November they launched a coordinated land-and-water assault on Wuhan. Guan Wen led separate columns while the navy struck Hanyang's east gate and broke the Wuxian Temple stockade. Li Mengqun defeated Guishan reinforcements, and Wang Guocai and Yang Changsi entered through the west gate. Hanyang was recovered and more than five hundred rebel officers were captured.

sentences.zh: 林翼亦復武昌，詔嘉獎，賜花翎。

translations.literal: Linyi also recovered Wuchang; an edict praised and rewarded them, granting peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Linyi also recovered Wuchang. The court issued a commendatory edict and granted peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 七年，偕林翼疏言：「湖北為長江上游要害，武漢尤九省通衢，自來東南有事必爭之地。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, together with Linyi he memorialized, saying: "Hubei is the strategic key to the upper Yangtze; Wuhan especially is the thoroughfare of nine provinces and has always been contested whenever trouble arises in the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: In 1857 he and Hu Linyi memorialized: "Hubei guards the upper Yangtze, and Wuhan is the hub of nine provinces — a prize whenever the southeast is in turmoil.

sentences.zh: 三次失陷，力攻兩載而後克之。

translations.literal: It fell three times and was taken only after two years of strenuous attack.
translations.idiomatic: It fell three times and was retaken only after two years of hard fighting.

sentences.zh: 目前相機防剿，不令賊乘間上竄，蹈從前覆轍。

translations.literal: At present we plan defense and suppression as circumstances allow, not permitting the rebels to seize an opening to flee upstream and repeat former disasters.
translations.idiomatic: We must now defend and suppress as circumstances allow, not letting rebels slip upstream and repeat past disasters.

sentences.zh: 業派李續賓由南岸，都興阿、孔廣順、王國才由北岸，楊載福率水師由江路分道進剿。

translations.literal: We have already dispatched Li Xubin along the south bank, Du Xing'a, Kong Guangshun, and Wang Guocai along the north bank, and Yang Zaifu leading the naval force along the river route in separate columns for pursuit and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xubin advances on the south bank, Du Xing'a, Kong Guangshun, and Wang Guocai on the north bank, and Yang Zaifu leads the fleet up the river in separate columns.

sentences.zh: 現北岸黃州至黃梅，南岸武昌至興國，均已肅清，崇、通一帶搜捕殆盡；

translations.literal: At present on the north bank from Huangzhou to Huangmei and on the south bank from Wuchang to Xingguo, all have been pacified, and in the Chongyang-Tongcheng region pursuit is nearly complete;
translations.idiomatic: The north bank from Huangzhou to Huangmei and the south bank from Wuchang to Xingguo are now cleared, and pursuit in the Chongyang-Tongcheng region is nearly complete;

sentences.zh: 李續賓抵九江，與曾國籓會合進攻；

translations.literal: Li Xubin has reached Jiujiang and joined Zeng Guofan in a joint advance;
translations.idiomatic: Li Xubin has reached Jiujiang and joined Zeng Guofan in a joint attack;

sentences.zh: 楊載福毀城外賊營；

translations.literal: Yang Zaifu has destroyed rebel camps outside the city walls;
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zaifu has destroyed rebel camps outside the walls;

sentences.zh: 惟小池口賊壘未拔，派鮑超助攻。

translations.literal: only the rebel fort at Xiaochikou has not been taken, and Bao Chao has been dispatched to assist the attack.
translations.idiomatic: only the fort at Xiaochikou remains, and Bao Chao has been sent to assist.

sentences.zh: 安徽之英山、太湖、宿松、望江接壤湖北，皆為賊藪，有窺伺上犯之心。

translations.literal: In Anhui, Yingshan, Taihu, Susong, and Wangjiang border Hubei and are all rebel lairs, with intent to watch for opportunities to invade upstream.
translations.idiomatic: Yingshan, Taihu, Susong, and Wangjiang in Anhui border Hubei and remain rebel strongholds poised to strike upstream.

sentences.zh: 飭王國才駐黃梅之大河鋪、界嶺岩，孔廣順駐蘄水之孔隴驛，巴揚阿率馬隊為各路應援，以固楚北門戶。

translations.literal: Wang Guocai is ordered to station at Dahepu and Jielingyan in Huangmei, Kong Guangshun at Konglong Post in Qishui, and Bayang'a to lead cavalry as relief for all routes, to secure the northern gateway of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Guocai is posted at Dahepu and Jielingyan in Huangmei, Kong Guangshun at Konglong in Qishui, and Bayang'a leads cavalry as reserve for all routes to secure Hubei's northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 道士洑水闊溜急，田家鎮兩山對峙，水師皆難久駐，酌留各營遊巡江面，足備鎮馭。

translations.literal: At Daoshi the river is wide and the current swift; at Tianjiazhen two mountains face each other — the naval force cannot long remain at either place. It is planned to leave detachments from each camp to patrol the river surface, sufficient to maintain control.
translations.idiomatic: At Daoshi the river is wide and swift; at Tianjiazhen mountains rise on both banks — neither place suits a long naval stay. Detachments will patrol the river to maintain control.

sentences.zh: 通籌大局，我軍已據水陸上游，實蓄破竹建瓴之勢。

translations.literal: Considering the overall situation, our army already holds the upstream by land and water and truly possesses the momentum of splitting bamboo and pouring from a high roof.
translations.idiomatic: Taken as a whole, our forces hold the upstream by land and water and now have irresistible momentum.

sentences.zh: 所慮江西七府未平，武昌尚有肘腋之患。

translations.literal: What is feared is that the seven prefectures of Jiangxi are not yet pacified and Wuchang still has trouble at its flanks.
translations.idiomatic: Our concern is that Jiangxi's seven prefectures are not yet pacified and Wuchang remains exposed on its flanks.

sentences.zh: 賊若由通城、崇陽、興國竄逼武昌，反出江西各軍之上，自當固守武昌，以為後路根本。

translations.literal: If rebels flee through Tongcheng, Chongyang, and Xingguo to press on Wuchang and emerge above the various Jiangxi armies, we should naturally hold Wuchang firm as the fundamental base of our rear route.
translations.idiomatic: If rebels slip through Tongcheng, Chongyang, and Xingguo to threaten Wuchang and get behind the Jiangxi armies, we must hold Wuchang as the base of our rear supply line.

sentences.zh: 相機籌畫，節節進取，仍步步嚴防，庶軍情無返顧掣肘之虞，轉餉有源源不竭之利。

translations.literal: Planning as circumstances allow, advancing step by step while still guarding strictly at every step, we may hope that military affairs will have no worry of looking back or being checked, and transport of supplies will have the benefit of an unceasing flow.
translations.idiomatic: We should advance step by step while guarding every position, so the army need not fear being cut off and supplies may flow without interruption.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，報聞。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, acknowledgment was returned.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was received and noted.

sentences.zh: 初，官文由荊州將軍調總督，凡上游荊、市、襄、鄖諸郡兵事餉事悉主之。

translations.literal: At first, when Guan Wen was transferred from general of Jingzhou to governor-general, he oversaw all military and supply affairs of the upstream prefectures Jing, Shi, Xiang, and Yun.
translations.idiomatic: When Guan Wen moved from general of Jingzhou to governor-general, he controlled military and supply affairs for the upstream prefectures.

sentences.zh: 林翼以巡撫駐金口，凡下游武、漢、黃、德諸郡兵事餉事悉主之。

translations.literal: Linyi as governor was stationed at Jinkou and oversaw all military and supply affairs of the downstream prefectures Wu, Han, Huang, and De.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Linyi as governor was stationed at Jinkou and controlled military and supply affairs for the downstream prefectures.

sentences.zh: 南北軍各領分地，徵兵調餉，每有違言。

translations.literal: The northern and southern armies each held separate territories; in recruiting troops and transferring supplies there were often disputes.
translations.idiomatic: The northern and southern armies each held separate territory, and disputes often arose over recruitment and supplies.

sentences.zh: 武昌既复，林翼威望日起，官文自知不及，思假以為重，林翼益推誠相結納，於是吏治、財政、軍事悉聽林翼主持，官文畫諾而已。

translations.literal: Once Wuchang was recovered, Linyi's prestige rose daily. Guan Wen knew himself unequal and wished to borrow his weight; Linyi all the more extended sincerity in alliance. Thereupon civil administration, finance, and military affairs were all left to Linyi's direction, and Guan Wen merely affixed his approval.
translations.idiomatic: After Wuchang was recovered, Hu Linyi's prestige grew daily. Guan Wen knew he could not match him and sought to share in his authority; Hu Linyi responded with sincere cooperation. Civil administration, finance, and military affairs were left to Hu Linyi, and Guan Wen merely signed off.

sentences.zh: 不數年，足食足兵，東南大局，隱然以湖北為之樞。

translations.literal: Within a few years there was sufficient food and sufficient troops; the great situation of the southeast quietly took Hubei as its pivot.
translations.idiomatic: Within a few years Hubei had ample food and troops and quietly became the pivot of the southeastern campaign.

sentences.zh: 八年四月，复九江，論功，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the eighth year, Jiujiang was recovered; for merit he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In April 1858 Jiujiang was recovered, and he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent for merit.

sentences.zh: 皖賊陷麻城、黃安，圍蘄州，先後破走之。

translations.literal: Anhui rebels captured Macheng and Huang'an and besieged Qizhou; he defeated and drove them off in succession.
translations.idiomatic: When Anhui rebels took Macheng and Huang'an and besieged Qizhou, he defeated and drove them off in turn.

sentences.zh: 七月，胡林翼丁母憂，官文疏請留林翼治軍，改為署理，從之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Hu Linyi entered mourning for his mother; Guan Wen memorialized requesting that Linyi remain to command the army and be changed to acting status; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In July Hu Linyi entered mourning for his mother. Guan Wen asked that he remain to command the army as acting governor, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 命官文暫行兼署巡撫，尋以湖廣總督協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Guan Wen was ordered temporarily to serve concurrently as acting governor, and soon afterward was made Grand Secretary assisting as governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen was made acting governor and soon afterward Grand Secretary with concurrent rank as governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 李續賓戰歿三河，皖、鄂震動。

translations.literal: Li Xubin was killed in battle at Sanhe; Anhui and Hubei were shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xubin was killed at Sanhe, shaking Anhui and Hubei.

sentences.zh: 官文分兵扼蘄州、廣濟、麻城諸隘，固守九江、彭澤，水師嚴防江面，人心始定。

translations.literal: Guan Wen divided troops to hold the passes at Qizhou, Guangji, and Macheng, firmly defended Jiujiang and Pengze, and had the naval force strictly guard the river surface; popular sentiment then settled.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen posted troops at Qizhou, Guangji, and Macheng, held Jiujiang and Pengze, and had the navy guard the river, steadying public morale.

sentences.zh: 九年，賊竄湖南，圍寶慶，檄荊宜施道李續宜赴援，大破之，寶慶圍解。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, rebels fled into Hunan and besieged Baoqing; an order was sent to Jing-Yi-Shi circuit intendant Li Xuyi to go in relief; he inflicted a great defeat and the siege of Baoqing was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: In 1859 rebels entered Hunan and besieged Baoqing. Li Xuyi was ordered to reinforce and inflicted a crushing defeat, lifting the siege.

sentences.zh: 十二月，复太湖，被優敘。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Taihu was recovered; he received preferential commendation.
translations.idiomatic: In December Taihu was recovered and he received special commendation.

sentences.zh: 十一年，拜文淵閣大學士，仍留總督任。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Depths and remained in the governor-general's post.
translations.idiomatic: In 1861 he was made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Depths while retaining the governorship.

sentences.zh: 時大軍圍安慶急，陳玉成、李秀成先後分兵犯湖北境，冀掣動局勢，遣將迭破之，所陷諸郡縣皆复。

translations.literal: At the time the main army was pressing the siege of Anqing urgently; Chen Yucheng and Li Xiucheng successively divided troops to invade Hubei territory, hoping to shake the situation; he dispatched generals who repeatedly defeated them, and all fallen prefectures and counties were recovered.
translations.idiomatic: While the main army pressed the siege of Anqing, Chen Yucheng and Li Xiucheng sent separate columns into Hubei to relieve the pressure. Guan Wen's generals defeated them repeatedly and recovered all lost counties.

sentences.zh: 八月，克安慶，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Anqing was captured; he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In August Anqing fell, and he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 是年，胡林翼病歿，嚴樹森代之。

translations.literal: That year Hu Linyi died of illness and Yan Shusen replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: That year Hu Linyi died of illness and was succeeded by Yan Shusen.

sentences.zh: 降捻苗沛霖踞安徽壽州，詔疆臣議剿撫之策。

translations.literal: The surrendered Nian leader Miao Peilin held Shouzhou in Anhui; an edict ordered frontier officials to deliberate policies of suppression or pacification.
translations.idiomatic: The surrendered Nian leader Miao Peilin held Shouzhou in Anhui, and the court ordered provincial officials to debate whether to suppress or pacify him.

sentences.zh: 官文疏陳沛霖包藏禍心，罪大惡極，請伸天討。

translations.literal: Guan Wen memorialized stating that Peilin harbored treacherous intent, his crimes were grave and his evil extreme, and he requested execution of Heaven's punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen memorialized that Peilin harbored treacherous intent and deserved Heaven's punishment.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，遣副將周鳳山等剿捻於河南信陽、羅山，敗之；

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, he dispatched deputy commander Zhou Fengshan and others to suppress the Nian in Xinyang and Luoshan in Henan and defeated them;
translations.idiomatic: In 1862 he sent Zhou Fengshan and others to suppress the Nian in Xinyang and Luoshan, Henan, and defeated them;

sentences.zh: 又破黃梅捻巢，收復十餘寨：晉文華殿大學士。

translations.literal: he also broke the Nian nest in Huangmei and recovered more than ten stockades: he was promoted to Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Glory.
translations.idiomatic: he also destroyed a Nian stronghold in Huangmei and recovered more than ten stockades, and was promoted to Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Glory.

sentences.zh: 發、捻合擾楚、豫之交，勢甚熾。

translations.literal: Taiping and Nian forces together harassed the border of Chu and Yu; their momentum was very fierce.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping and Nian forces together ravaged the Hubei-Henan border with fierce momentum.

sentences.zh: 荊州將軍多隆阿方督師赴陝西，官文以楚兵不敷分佈，奏調回援。

translations.literal: Jingzhou General Dolon'a was then commanding troops to Shaanxi; Guan Wen, because Chu troops were insufficient for distribution, memorialized to recall him for relief.
translations.idiomatic: General Dolon'a was marching to Shaanxi, but Guan Wen, finding Hubei's troops overstretched, memorialized to recall him.

sentences.zh: 九月，多隆阿至，屢戰皆捷，襄河以北賊皆遠遁。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Dolon'a arrived; successive battles were all victorious, and north of the Xiang River the rebels all fled far away.
translations.idiomatic: In September Dolon'a arrived, won a series of victories, and drove all rebels north of the Xiang far away.

sentences.zh: 三年，劾巡撫嚴樹森把持剛愎，黜之。

translations.literal: In the third year, he impeached Governor Yan Shusen for domineering obstinacy and had him removed.
translations.idiomatic: In 1864 he impeached Governor Yan Shusen for domineering obstinacy and had him dismissed.

sentences.zh: 六月，克復江寧，曾國籓奏捷，推官文列名疏首。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Jiangning was recovered; Zeng Guofan memorialized victory and placed Guan Wen's name at the head of the memorial.
translations.idiomatic: In June Nanjing was recovered. Zeng Guofan reported the victory with Guan Wen's name at the head of the memorial.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉官文徵兵籌餉，推賢讓能，接濟東征，不分畛域，錫封一等伯爵，號果威，世襲罔替，升入正白旗滿洲，賜雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: An edict praised Guan Wen for recruiting troops and raising supplies, promoting the worthy and yielding to the able, aiding the eastern campaign without regard to territorial boundaries. He was granted a first-class earldom, title Guowei, perpetual hereditary succession, elevation to the Manchu Plain White Banner, and double-eyed peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: The court praised Guan Wen for raising troops and supplies, promoting talent, aiding the eastern campaign without regard to boundaries, and granted him a perpetual first-class earldom titled Guowei, elevation to the Manchu Plain White Banner, and double-eyed peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 蓋褒其能與胡林翼和衷卒成大功也。

translations.literal: This was in praise of his ability to work in harmony with Hu Linyi and thereby achieve great success.
translations.idiomatic: This honored his ability to work in harmony with Hu Linyi and thereby achieve great success.

sentences.zh: 四年，僧格林沁剿捻戰歿於山東，詔追論前年發、捻擾湖北，官文不能就地殲除，僅驅出境，以致蔓延益熾，下嚴議，降三級調用，改革職留任，褫宮銜、花翎。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Sengge Rinchen was killed fighting the Nian in Shandong. An edict retrospectively discussed how in the previous year Taiping and Nian forces had harassed Hubei; Guan Wen could not destroy them on the spot but only drove them beyond the border, causing the disturbance to spread and grow fiercer. Severe deliberation was ordered: demotion by three ranks with transfer, retention in altered office, and stripping of palace rank and peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: In 1865 Sengge Rinchen was killed fighting the Nian in Shandong. The court reviewed how Taiping and Nian forces had harassed Hubei the year before. Guan Wen had only driven them out rather than destroying them locally, allowing the rebellion to spread. He was severely censured, demoted three ranks, kept in altered office, and stripped of palace rank and peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 五年，偕曾國籓奏設長江水師，如議行。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, together with Zeng Guofan he memorialized to establish the Yangtze naval force; it was carried out as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: In 1866 he and Zeng Guofan memorialized to establish the Yangtze naval force, and the proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 湖北巡撫曾國荃劾官文貪庸驕蹇，命尚書綿森、侍郎譚廷襄往按，坐動用捐款，議革職，詔念前勞，原其尚非貪污欺罔，優與保全，解總督，仍留大學士、伯爵，罰伯俸十年。

translations.literal: Hubei Governor Zeng Guoquan impeached Guan Wen for greed, mediocrity, arrogance, and obstinacy. Ministers Mian Sen and Vice Minister Tan Tingxiang were ordered to investigate. He was found guilty of misusing donated funds; removal from office was deliberated. An edict, recalling his former labors and excusing him as not yet guilty of corruption and deceit, granted lenient preservation: he was removed as governor-general but retained as Grand Secretary and earl, with earldom stipend fined for ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei Governor Zeng Guoquan impeached Guan Wen for greed, incompetence, and arrogance. Mian Sen and Tan Tingxiang were sent to investigate and found misuse of donated funds. The court, recalling his past service, removed him as governor-general but kept him as Grand Secretary and earl, fining his stipend for ten years.

sentences.zh: 召還京，管理刑部，兼正白旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: He was recalled to the capital, placed in charge of the Ministry of Punishments, and concurrently made commandant of the Mongol Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled to Beijing, placed in charge of the Ministry of Punishments, and made concurrent commandant of the Mongol Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 尋出署直隸總督。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he went out to serve as acting governor-general of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon posted as acting governor-general of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 七年，捻匪張總愚由西路竄擾畿輔，下嚴議。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, the Nian bandit Zhang Zongyu fled from the western route to harass the capital region; severe deliberation was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: In 1868 the Nian leader Zhang Zongyu raided the capital region from the west, and severe censure was ordered.

sentences.zh: 尋李鴻章、左宗棠等入援，七月，捻匪平，复宮銜、花翎。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Li Hongzhang, Zuo Zongtang, and others came in relief; in the seventh month the Nian were pacified, and his palace rank and peacock feathers were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang, Zuo Zongtang, and others then reinforced the campaign. In July the Nian were pacified, and his palace rank and peacock feathers were restored.

sentences.zh: 八年，回京，管理戶部三庫，授內大臣。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he returned to the capital, managed the three treasuries of the Ministry of Revenue, and was appointed inner court minister.
translations.idiomatic: In 1869 he returned to Beijing, managed the three treasuries of the Ministry of Revenue, and was made an inner court minister.

sentences.zh: 十年，卒，優詔賜卹，贈太保，賜金治喪，遣惠郡王奠醊，祀賢良祠，諡文恭。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, he died; a generous edict granted condolence gifts, he was posthumously made Grand Tutor, gold was granted for funeral arrangements, Prince Hui was dispatched to offer libations, he was enshrined in the Shrine of Worthy Officials, and given the posthumous title Wengong.
translations.idiomatic: He died in 1871. The court granted generous mourning honors, posthumously made him Grand Tutor, provided funds for his funeral, sent Prince Hui to offer libations, enshrined him in the Shrine of Worthy Officials, and gave him the posthumous title Wengong.

sentences.zh: 尋以疆臣請合祀湖北胡林翼專祠。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, at the request of frontier officials, he was jointly enshrined in Hu Linyi's special shrine in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: At the request of provincial officials, he was later enshrined jointly in Hu Linyi's memorial shrine in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 當官文之在湖北，事事聽林翼所為，惟馭下不嚴，用財不節，林翼憂之。

translations.literal: When Guan Wen was in Hubei, he let Linyi decide everything, but he was lax in controlling subordinates and extravagant in spending; Linyi worried about this.
translations.idiomatic: While Guan Wen was in Hubei he deferred to Hu Linyi on everything, but he was lax with subordinates and extravagant in spending, which troubled Hu Linyi.

sentences.zh: 閻敬銘方佐治餉，一日林翼與言，恐誤疆事。

translations.literal: Yan Jingming was then assisting in managing supplies; one day Linyi spoke with him, fearing frontier affairs might be harmed.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Jingming was then managing supplies when Hu Linyi confided his fear that frontier affairs might suffer.

sentences.zh: 敬銘曰：「公誤矣！

translations.literal: Jingming said: "Your Excellency is mistaken!
translations.idiomatic: Yan Jingming replied: "Your Excellency is mistaken!

sentences.zh: 本朝不輕以漢大臣專兵柄。

translations.literal: This dynasty does not lightly entrust military authority solely to Han ministers.
translations.idiomatic: The dynasty does not lightly entrust sole military authority to Han ministers.

sentences.zh: 今滿、漢並用，而聲績炳著者多屬漢人，此聖明大公劃除畛域之效。

translations.literal: Now Manchu and Han are employed together, yet those of brilliant reputation and achievement are mostly Han — this is the effect of the sage emperor's great fairness in erasing territorial boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: Manchu and Han serve together now, yet most of the celebrated achievers are Han — a sign of the emperor's fairness in erasing ethnic boundaries.

sentences.zh: 然湖北居天下要衝，朝廷寧肯不以親信大臣臨之？

translations.literal: Yet Hubei occupies the strategic pass of the empire — would the court be willing not to place a trusted intimate minister over it?
translations.idiomatic: Yet Hubei is the empire's strategic hub — would the court fail to place a trusted intimate there?

sentences.zh: 夫督撫相劾，無論未必勝，即勝，能保後來者必賢耶？

translations.literal: As for governor-general and governor impeaching each other, setting aside whether one would necessarily win, even if one wins, can one guarantee the successor will be worthy?
translations.idiomatic: If governor and governor-general impeach each other, victory is uncertain — and even if you win, can you guarantee a worthy successor?

sentences.zh: 且繼者或厲清操，勤庶務，而不明遠略，未必不顓己自是，豈甘事事讓人？
